assets.name: Character puppet
assets.description: The stick figure itself: head, torso, arms, legs and hands. Every person on screen is this puppet with a pose, a face and optional skin, hair and costume.
assets.use: <Character x groundY head pose face turn facing identity outfit prop />. A smaller head makes a child.

assets.name: Back view
assets.description: A character seen from behind: no face, hair and headwear covering the back of the head, a cape hanging over the body. For the near person in an over-the-shoulder shot, or someone walking away.
assets.use: <Character back ... /> with any costume, hair or age

assets.name: Stand
assets.description: Standing still with the arms hanging at the sides. The default pose.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(stand)}

assets.name: Wave
assets.description: One arm raised in a wave, the other at the side.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(wave)}

assets.name: Point
assets.description: One arm stretched out with a pointing finger, leaning slightly forward.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(point)}

assets.name: Shrug
assets.description: Both forearms raised to the sides and the head tilted, as in "I do not know".
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(shrug)}

assets.name: Hands up
assets.description: Both arms raised above the head, knees a little bent.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(handsUp)}

assets.name: Hold object
assets.description: One arm reaching out with a closed fist around an upright object such as a staff, the other arm relaxed.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(holdObject)}

assets.name: Hands over mouth
assets.description: Both hands pressed over the mouth in shock.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(handsOverMouth)}

assets.name: Sit
assets.description: Sitting on a seat as high as the shins: thighs level, shins down, hands on the lap. Needs a seat, throne, rock or ledge under it.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(sit)} with a seat body.shin high under the hip; best three-quarter or profile

assets.name: Kneel
assets.description: Down on one knee with the other foot planted, a hand on the raised knee and the head bowed.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(kneel)}; best three-quarter or profile

assets.name: Lie down
assets.description: Lying on the ground on one side with the head down, one arm along the body and one reaching forward.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(lie)} with turn={0}; the figure is about three heads long

assets.name: Cross arms
assets.description: Standing with both arms folded across the chest.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(crossArms)}

assets.name: Look up
assets.description: Standing with the head tipped back to look at something above.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(lookUp)} with lookAt on the thing above

assets.name: Look down
assets.description: Standing with the head bowed to look at something below.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(lookDown)} with lookAt on the thing below

assets.name: Cower
assets.description: Crouched and hunched with both arms raised over the head.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(cower)} with the afraid face

assets.name: Hug
assets.description: Leaning in with both arms wrapped around someone standing close in front. Two characters in this pose, facing each other, make a hug.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(hug)} on two characters about 1.2 head-widths apart, facing each other

assets.name: Walk
assets.description: A walking cycle with planted feet and swinging arms. The character moves forward as time passes.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}; the camera follows w.pose.rootX

assets.name: Proud walk
assets.description: A slow strut: chest out, chin up, high steps and a wide arm swing.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.proud); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Tired walk
assets.description: A slow trudge: short steps that barely leave the ground, bent forward with the head down and the arms hanging.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.tired); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Sneaky walk
assets.description: Creeping on high careful steps: crouched, head pushed forward, hands held up in front.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.sneaky); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Happy walk
assets.description: A quick bouncy walk with a big arm swing and the head up.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.happy); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Cheer
assets.description: Arms thrown up in a V and pumping, the body bouncing on bent knees. Loops.
assets.use: pose={cheerAt(frame / fps)} with the laughing or happy face

assets.name: Cry
assets.description: The face in both hands with the head bowed, shoulders shaking in bursts of sobs. Loops.
assets.use: pose={cryAt(frame / fps)} with the wailing or sad face

assets.name: Run
assets.description: A flat-out run: both feet off the ground between steps, the body thrown forward, elbows pumping. Loops.
assets.use: const r = walkAt(frame / fps, GAITS.run); pose={r.pose} with turn={1}; the body moves forward by r.pose.rootX

assets.name: Carry a load
assets.description: Walking with a load held in both arms in front of the body, leaning back against the weight. Loops.
assets.use: pose={walkAt(frame / fps, GAITS.carry).pose} and draw the load at the two hands with the prop slot

assets.name: Push
assets.description: Pushing something heavy: the body leans hard into both arms and drives forward with short steps. Loops.
assets.use: pose={walkAt(frame / fps, GAITS.push).pose}; move the pushed thing with the body

assets.name: Pull
assets.description: Pulling on a rope or handle held in both fists, leaning back and stepping backward. Loops.
assets.use: pose={walkAt(-frame / fps, GAITS.pull).pose} (time runs backward, so the feet step backward)

assets.name: Jump
assets.description: A jump: crouch with the arms back, spring up with the arms high, tuck the legs, land on bent knees and stand. Takes 1.1 seconds.
assets.use: pose={jumpAt(seconds, height, distance)} with seconds counted from the start of the jump

assets.name: Fall forward
assets.description: Falling flat on the face, as after a trip: toppling forward with the arms out, hitting the ground, one bounce, lying still.
assets.use: pose={fallAt(seconds)}; it ends lying down and stays there

assets.name: Fall backward
assets.description: Knocked flat on the back: going over backward with the arms flailing, landing, one bounce, lying still with a knee up.
assets.use: pose={fallBackAt(seconds)}; follow a recoil with it for a knock-down

assets.name: Punch
assets.description: A punch: the fist cocks back, the body steps in and the arm shoots straight out, holds a beat and returns. The hit lands 0.22 seconds in.
assets.use: pose={punchAt(seconds)}; put an Impact flash at the fist at PUNCH.hit and start the other person recoilAt there

assets.name: Swing a held thing
assets.description: Swinging something held in the front hand: up and back over the shoulder, down hard in front with a step, follow through, back to upright.
assets.use: pose={swingAt(seconds)} with a prop in the front hand; the hit lands at SWING.hit

assets.name: Recoil from a hit
assets.description: Being hit from the front: the head snaps back, the body buckles away, two stumbling steps backward, then upright again.
assets.use: pose={recoilAt(seconds)} with seconds counted from the moment the blow lands; add a head squash on the first frames

assets.name: Float
assets.description: Hanging in the air with no gravity: the body bobs slowly, arms and legs drifting loose.
assets.use: action: "float"

assets.name: Blinks and breathing
assets.description: Small movement while a character holds a pose: blinks every few seconds, breathing, a slight head bob and a slow shift of weight from leg to leg.
assets.use: pose={withLife(pose, frame, fps, seed)} blink={blinkAt(frame, fps, seed)}

assets.name: Talking mouth
assets.description: The mouth forms the spoken words of one voice line with five shapes: closed, half, open, wide (ee) and round (oo).
assets.use: talk={talkAt(frame, fps, wordsOfTheLine)} where the words are the voice track words of that line

assets.name: Moves one after another
assets.description: Plays actions in turn, such as sneak, then run, then jump: each starts where the last one left the body, with a short blend at each change so nothing pops.
assets.use: pose={chainAt(seconds, [{ from: 0, at: sneak }, { from: 1.3, at: run }, { from: 3.1, at: jumpAt }])}; pose.rootX is how far the character has travelled

assets.name: Pose changes with wind-up and settle
assets.description: Moving from one pose to the next: a short wind-up the other way before a big move, a quick snap, a small overshoot and a dip of the hips, then the hold.
assets.use: pose={poseAt(frame, [{ frame: 0, pose: stand }, { frame: 40, pose: wave }])}

assets.name: Capes, hair and held things swing
assets.description: Loose things lag behind the body: a cape or cloak hem and long hair trail a walk and swing on past when the body stops, and the top of a held staff tips back as the arm moves.
assets.use: sway={swayOf((f) => poseOfThisCharacterAt(f), frame, fps)} with the same function the scene uses for the pose

assets.name: Eye darts
assets.description: Small quick glances to the side every second or two, so the eyes are never frozen during a hold.
assets.use: gaze={gazeAt(frame, fps, seed)}

assets.name: Smooth head turn
assets.description: Turning to look the other way or toward a speaker: the head and body swing through the front view over a few frames instead of flipping.
assets.use: const t = turnAt(frame, [{ frame: 0, facing: "right", turn: 0.5 }, { frame: 60, facing: "left", turn: 0.5 }]); facing={t.facing} turn={t.turn}

assets.name: Ice planet

assets.name: Black hole

assets.use: <BlackHole uid shadowSide={1} r={1.2} t={seconds} />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "black-hole", x: 0.5, y: 4 }]

assets.name: Rocket

assets.name: Rocket in flight

assets.name: Flying sweat drops
assets.description: Light blue drops that fly out from the head in arcs and fade, on a loop. For fear, panic and strain.
assets.use: headEffects={<FlyingSweat t={frame / fps} seed={seed} />}

assets.name: Resting sweat drop
assets.description: One light blue drop sitting on the head. For worry, effort and tiredness.
assets.use: headEffects={<RestingSweat side={-1} />}

assets.name: Dollar eyes
assets.description: Gold coins with a dollar sign pop up over both eyes: greed taking over. For the one turning point of a video, not as decoration.
assets.use: on a person in a shot: effects: [{ effect: "dollar-eyes", on: "<id>" }]

assets.name: Shock lines
assets.description: Short lines burst out round the head: the moment something lands. For the one turning point of a video.
assets.use: on a person in a shot: effects: [{ effect: "shock-lines", on: "<id>" }]

assets.name: Streams of tears
assets.description: Light blue streams running from both eyes down the cheeks and off the jaw, with drops flying off. For bawling, with the wailing face.

assets.name: Tear drops

assets.use: headEffects={<TearDrops turn={turn} t={frame / fps} />} with the same turn as the character

assets.name: Anger mark
assets.description: A red cross-shaped vein mark that throbs near the top of the head. For anger and rage.
assets.use: headEffects={<AngerMark t={frame / fps} />} with the angry or shouting face

assets.name: Dizzy stars
assets.description: Small gold stars circling the top of the head. For someone dazed, knocked silly or confused after a hit or a fall.
assets.use: headEffects={<DizzyStars t={frame / fps} />} after a recoil or a fall

assets.name: Exclamation mark
assets.description: A bold outlined ! that pops in over the head. For surprise, alarm or a sudden idea.
assets.use: headEffects={<HeadSymbol kind="!" t={secondsSinceItAppeared} />}

assets.name: Question mark
assets.description: A bold outlined ? that pops in over the head. For puzzlement, doubt or thinking.
assets.use: headEffects={<HeadSymbol kind="?" t={secondsSinceItAppeared} />}

assets.name: Three dots
assets.description: Three bold outlined dots that pop in one after another over the head. For a stunned or awkward silence.
assets.use: headEffects={<HeadSymbol kind="..." t={secondsSinceItAppeared} />}

assets.name: Impact flash
assets.description: A brief white starburst with a black outline that bursts out and vanishes. For a blow, a crash or a hard landing; it covers the point of contact.

assets.name: Motion lines
assets.description: Short black lines trailing something that moves fast: a runner, a fist, a thrown thing.

assets.name: Explosion

assets.name: Fire
assets.description: A fire burning on the ground: three tongues of flame that lick and sway, orange outside and gold within, with smoke if wanted.
assets.use: <Fire t={seconds} size={1.4} smoke />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "fire", x: 0.6 }]

assets.name: Pencil line

assets.name: Rubbed out
assets.description: Part of a person or a thing fades to a faint grey outline, as if an eraser had gone over it, and crumbs of the rubbing fall away.

assets.name: Smoke

assets.use: <Smoke t={seconds} size={1} />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "smoke", x: 0.6 }]

assets.name: Slow push-in
assets.description: The camera moves slowly closer to a focus point over a shot. For emotional lines.
assets.use: <PushIn frame durationInFrames strength={0.08} focus={{ x, y }}>...</PushIn>

assets.name: Slow pull-back
assets.description: The camera starts close and moves slowly back over a shot, to show where someone is, or to leave them behind at the end.
assets.use: in a shot: camera: { framing, move: "pull-back", strength: 0.3 }

assets.name: Slow drift
assets.description: The camera floats slowly sideways across a shot, never stopping and never hurrying, so a held picture still breathes.
assets.use: in a shot: camera: { framing, move: "drift", strength: 0.4 }

assets.name: Finish: grain and darker edges
assets.description: A fine moving grain over the picture and edges a little darker, so it stops looking machine-clean. Set with soft shadows, gentle acting and moving on twos in a video's finish.
assets.use: a format's or storyboard's finish: { acting: "gentle", onTwos: true, shadows: true, grain: 0.5, vignette: 0.5 }

assets.name: Fast push-in
assets.description: The camera jumps closer to a focus point in a few frames and holds. For a shock, a reveal or the instant of a hit.
assets.use: <PunchIn frame={frame} at={hitFrame} strength={0.18} focus={{ x, y }}>...</PunchIn>

assets.name: Camera shake
assets.description: The whole picture jolts and settles in about a third of a second. For an impact: a blow, a crash, a landing, thunder.
assets.use: <Shake frame={frame} fps={fps} at={hitFrame} width={width} height={height}>...</Shake>; at can be a list of frames

assets.name: Pan
assets.description: The camera slides sideways or up and down across a scene bigger than the frame. Over a few frames it is a whip pan, kept for the change between scenes.
assets.use: <Pan frame={frame} from={startFrame} to={endFrame} dx={px}>...</Pan>; the scene must be drawn wider than the frame

assets.name: Following camera
assets.description: The camera rides along with a character that travels a long way, such as a runner in a chase. The background is set to endless, so the hills, trees and grass repeat and never run out.
assets.use: <Background spec={spec} cameraX={travelledPx} endless ... /> where travelledPx is pose.rootX * head; draw the followed character at a fixed screen x and everyone else at their world x minus travelledPx

assets.name: Quick fade between scenes
assets.description: The picture dips to dark and comes back on the next scene. For a change of place or time; shots inside one scene change with a plain cut.
assets.use: <Fade frame={frame} at={frameTheSceneChanges} width={width} height={height} /> drawn over everything

assets.name: Wide shot
assets.description: Whole figures with their surroundings. The layout every scene starts from: it shows where everyone is.
assets.use: <Framed shot="wide" focus={focusBetween(focusOn(a, poseA), focusOn(b, poseB))} width height>scene</Framed>

assets.name: Medium shot
assets.description: A person from the head to about the hips, or two people together. The everyday shot for talk and action.
assets.use: <Framed shot="medium" focus={focusOn(person, pose)} width height>the same wide scene</Framed>

assets.name: Close-up
assets.description: One face filling about two fifths of the frame. For the feeling on a face at an important moment.
assets.use: <Framed shot="close-up" focus={focusOn(person, pose)} width height>the same wide scene</Framed>

assets.name: Over the shoulder
assets.description: The person being looked at, past the back of the head and shoulder of the one looking. For a conversation or showing something to someone.
assets.use: <Framed shot="over-shoulder" focus={focusOn(far, pose)} ...>scene</Framed> then <Character {...shoulderPlacement(size)} back ... /> on top

assets.name: Captions
assets.description: White Fredoka captions with a black outline in the bottom quarter, two short lines at a time, the emphasized word in gold.
assets.use: <Captions pages={buildPages(toCaptions(track.words))} />

assets.name: Title card
assets.description: A ribbon banner across the upper part of the frame with the title in white and an optional smaller line under it. Pops in with a small bounce. For the name of a video or a chapter.
assets.use: <TitleCard title="The Golden Coin" subtitle="A folktale" width height frame={framesSinceItAppeared} paint="crimson" />

assets.name: Label
assets.description: A small outlined box with dark text at the top of the frame, for a place, a date, a time or a name.
assets.use: <Label text="That evening" at="top-left" width height frame={framesSinceItAppeared} />

assets.name: Page mark
assets.description: The page's name, small and see-through, in one corner of every frame. A bottom corner sits just above the caption band. Drawn only when the brand file has a watermark.
assets.use: <Watermark mark={{ text: "Page name", corner: "top-right", opacity: 0.75 }} width height />

assets.name: Closing card
assets.description: The card after the last shot: the page's line on a ribbon over a quiet flat field, with an optional smaller line under it. Added by the output step when the brand file has a closing card.
assets.use: <ClosingCard text="Thanks for watching" subtext="A new story every week" width height frame={framesSinceItBegan} />

assets.name: Big number
assets.description: The one figure a shot is about, large in gold with a black outline, and an optional short line under it in a cream box.
assets.use: overlay: { kind: "number", text: "1,670 km/h", caption: "how fast the ground moves" }

assets.name: Arrow with a label
assets.description: A cream box with a few words and a bold arrow from it to the thing it names.
assets.use: overlay: { kind: "pointer", text: "The Moon", at: { x: 0.3, y: 0.2 }, to: { x: 0.6, y: 0.35 } }

assets.name: Story gauge
assets.description: A small plate at the top of the picture that carries the story: a number that counts up or down, a bar that fills or drains, or steps such as 2/3, each changing on a spoken word.

assets.name: Orbit diagram
assets.description: One thing in the middle, a tilted dashed ring round it, and a smaller thing going round on the ring. For reading, not to scale.
assets.use: overlay: { kind: "orbit", center: "earth", around: "moon" }

assets.name: Tense music
assets.description: Danger close by: a low pulse, trembling strings and a waiting drum. For threats, chases about to start, a secret about to come out.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "music": [{ "mood": "tense", "startMs": 0 }]

assets.name: Sorrowful music
assets.description: Loss and regret: a slow piano under a cello line. For a death, a parting, a defeat.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "music": [{ "mood": "sorrow", "startMs": 0 }]

assets.name: Hopeful music
assets.description: Things may turn out well: rising piano, warm strings and a flute. For a new start, a plan forming, help arriving.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "music": [{ "mood": "hope", "startMs": 0 }]

assets.name: Triumphant music
assets.description: A win: brass, a marching drum and a trumpet tune. For a victory, a crowning, a goal reached.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "music": [{ "mood": "triumph", "startMs": 0 }]

assets.name: Reflective music
assets.description: Thinking it over: soft electric piano and a few vibraphone notes. For a lesson, a memory, the quiet after an event.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "music": [{ "mood": "reflective", "startMs": 0 }]

assets.name: Curious music
assets.description: Something odd to find out: plucked strings and a marimba that pokes about. For a question, a mystery, an opening hook.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "music": [{ "mood": "curious", "startMs": 0 }]

assets.name: Upbeat music
assets.description: Good news and energy: strummed guitar, bass, drums and a bright piano tune. For lists, facts, a happy ending.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "music": [{ "mood": "upbeat", "startMs": 0 }]

assets.name: Calm music
assets.description: Peace and rest: a harp, a soft pad and a little flute. For a quiet scene, nature, sleep, walking home.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "music": [{ "mood": "calm", "startMs": 0 }]

assets.name: Comic music
assets.description: Something silly: an oom-pah tuba and a bassoon with a spring in its step. For a fool, a mishap, a joke.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "music": [{ "mood": "comic", "startMs": 0 }]

assets.name: Uneasy music
assets.description: Something is wrong and nobody says so: one low held note, far strings and a few lonely piano notes with a lot of room between them. For a dark room before anything happens, a test nobody was told about, a calm that should not be trusted.

assets.name: Closing-in music
assets.description: The trap shuts: a tight plucked figure that will not stop, a drum like a pulse and low strings pressing in. For the middle of a dilemma, when every way out costs something and the price keeps rising.
assets.use: a scene's mood: "closing-in"

assets.name: Aftermath music
assets.description: What is left when it is over: one slow low chord at a time and a cold, high bell line. For the result, the bill, the empty chair, the last look at the viewer.
assets.use: a scene's mood: "aftermath"

assets.name: Whoosh
assets.description: A fast move through the air. For a sword swing, a dash, a thrown thing, a quick camera move.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "whoosh", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Pop
assets.description: A small bright pop. For something appearing, a title or label landing, a bubble.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "pop", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Thud
assets.description: A heavy dull landing. For a fall, a dropped load, a door closing, a body hitting the ground.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "thud", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Click
assets.description: A tiny tick. For a latch, a switch, a lock, a cut on the beat.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "click", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Footsteps
assets.description: Steps on a hard floor, two a second, for as long as the walk lasts.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "footsteps", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Wind
assets.description: Open-air wind with soft gusts, running under a whole shot. For a storm sky, a hilltop, an empty street at night.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "wind", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Crowd murmur
assets.description: A room or street full of people talking with no words to make out, running under a whole shot. For a market, a court, a hall.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "crowd-murmur", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Creak
assets.description: Wood under strain. For a door opening slowly, a floorboard, a chair, a ship.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "creak", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Blip
assets.description: A drop: a quick rising plip. For a sweat drop, a tear, a small idea, a tiny surprise.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "blip", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Hit
assets.description: A cartoon blow landing, with no crunch. For a punch, a swing that connects, a bump.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "hit", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Ding
assets.description: A coin or a small bell ringing out. For money, a prize, a good idea, a right answer.
assets.use: sound-plan.json: "sfx": [{ "name": "ding", "atMs": 1200 }]

assets.name: Glowing envelope
assets.description: A gold envelope with a small seal that glows warm enough to light a room. Held up, or lying on the floor or a table.
assets.use: holds: "envelope", or props: [{ prop: "envelope", x }]; "from" slides it in under a door

assets.name: Bill
assets.description: A bill or letter: a cream sheet with a gold band across the top and a few lines of writing. Held up to read, or standing in a scene.
assets.use: holds: "bill", or props: [{ prop: "bill", x }]; to show what it says use the "page" overlay

assets.name: Pile of bills
assets.description: A small pile of ordinary bills lying on a table.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "bills", x, y: 1.3 }] to lie on a table

assets.name: Stack of coins
assets.description: A stack of a dozen gold coins, about one head tall. For money, a price, savings, or one bar of a comparison.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "coin-stack", x, tag: "USA, one year" }]; size makes it bigger

assets.name: Tower of coins
assets.description: A tower of gold coins nearly four heads tall. For a fortune, or the tall bar of a comparison beside a small stack.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "coin-tower", x, tag: "World, one year" }]

assets.name: Lump of coal
assets.description: A dark lump of coal with the green print of an old fern in it. For fuel, energy, mining and ancient plants.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "coal", x, tag: "SUNLIGHT" }]

assets.name: Fuel can
assets.description: A red fuel can with a spout and a grip. For petrol, oil, cars and energy.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "fuel-can", x }]

assets.name: Loaf of bread
assets.description: A loaf of bread with three cuts across its top. For food, dinner, a kitchen or hunger.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "bread", x, y: 1.3 }] to stand on a table

assets.name: Gust of wind
assets.description: Three pale lines of moving air that curl at the end and drift. Best over a dark or blue sky.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "wind", x, y }]

assets.name: Rain cloud
assets.description: A white cloud with drops falling from it on a loop.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "rain-cloud", x, y }]

assets.name: Coins raining down
assets.description: Gold coins that fall onto someone's head one after another, turning as they come. For money arriving, a windfall, a wage.
assets.use: effects: [{ effect: "coin-rain", on: "<person>" }]

assets.name: Open sea
assets.description: Open sea to the horizon with nothing on it, under any sky.
assets.use: placeSpec('sea', seed); in a scene: place "sea" with palette "clear-day"

assets.name: Empty plain
assets.description: An empty plain: low hills and grass, and nothing anyone built.
assets.use: placeSpec('plain', seed); in a scene: place "plain" with palette "clear-day"

assets.name: Bare rock
assets.description: Bare gray rock with a few dark hollows under the sky, before anything lived.
assets.use: placeSpec('bare-rock', seed); in a scene: place "bare-rock" with palette "cold-dawn"

assets.name: Bank vault
assets.description: A bank vault: a round steel door in the back wall and rows of locked boxes.
assets.use: placeSpec('vault', seed); in a scene: place "vault" with palette "storm-slate"

assets.name: Page held up to the camera
assets.description: A bill, letter or notice filling the picture: a cream sheet with a gold band and up to five short lines of writing, one of them marked in gold.
assets.use: overlay: { kind: "page", lines: ["FROM: THE SUN", "AMOUNT DUE: $30"], stress: 1 } in a shot with nobody in it

assets.name: Corner counter
assets.description: A counter in the top corner of the whole video: a dark plate with a few words and a gold number that climbs every frame, then stops and fades at the end.

assets.name: Tag on a thing
assets.description: A small cream tag on a short string tied to a thing in the scene, with a word or two on it. It pops up a moment into the shot.
assets.use: on a prop: { prop: "coal", x, tag: "SUNLIGHT" }

assets.name: Shipping crate
assets.description: A wooden shipping crate with THIS SIDE UP painted on its front, a lid, two battens and three small air holes. It hides whoever stands at its place.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "crate", x }]

assets.name: Shipping crate, upside down
assets.description: The shipping crate set down on its lid: THIS SIDE UP reads upside down and its arrow points at the ground.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "crate-upside-down", x }]

assets.name: Shipping crate, cut open
assets.description: The shipping crate with its front taken off to show the dark inside, with thin lines of light coming in through the air holes. Someone at its place is seen inside it.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "crate-cutaway", x }], with the person inside at the same x

assets.name: Shipping crate, cut open and upside down
assets.description: The cut-open crate standing on its lid, the words on the lid upside down. For someone folded up inside it on their head.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "crate-cutaway-upside-down", x }], with the person in the pose folded-upside-down 0.09 behind its x

assets.name: Wagon
assets.description: An open farm wagon seen from the side: a plank bed, two spoked wheels and the pole a horse is hitched to. People at its place stand in the bed, its side hiding their legs.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "wagon", x }], with its riders at about the same x

assets.name: Rope barrier
assets.description: Two wooden posts with a rope hanging between them: this far and no further.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "rope-barrier", x }]

assets.name: Wrist chains
assets.description: An iron cuff on each wrist and a chain hanging between the two hands, which follows the arms through any pose or walk. Worn, not held.
assets.use: holds: "chains" on a person

assets.name: Top hat
assets.description: A tall hat with a narrow brim and a band, in any cloth color. It sits just above the brows.
assets.use: outfit={outfitFrom({ ...clothes, hat: { kind: 'top-hat', cloth: 'steel' } })}

assets.name: Folded up, upside down
assets.description: Folded up inside a crate that stands on its lid: the head and one hand on the boards, the back sloping up, the knees doubled over the chest.
assets.use: pose: "folded-upside-down", inside the prop crate-cutaway-upside-down

assets.name: Heartbeat
assets.description: A heart pounding in the ears, a heavy thump and a lighter one, running under a whole shot. For fear, effort, hiding and waiting.
assets.use: a shot's sfx: [{ "name": "heartbeat", "at": "start" }]

assets.name: Rain
assets.description: Steady rain with a patter of single drops, running under a whole shot. For a wet street, a storm, a sad day.
assets.use: a shot's sfx: [{ "name": "rain", "at": "start" }]

assets.name: Clock tick
assets.description: A clock ticking twice a second, a tick and then a lower tock, dry and small, running under a whole shot. For a countdown, a deadline, a choice that has to be made now.
assets.use: a shot's sfx: [{ "name": "tick", "at": "start" }]

assets.name: Applause
assets.description: A studio audience clapping with no voices, a wash of many hands that swells in and thins out, running under a whole shot. For a game show, a stage, a win.
assets.use: a shot's sfx: [{ "name": "applause", "at": "start" }]

assets.name: Drum roll
assets.description: A snare drum roll of 1.8 seconds that builds and then stops dead, with no crash after it. For the moment before a reveal, a result, a winner.
assets.use: a shot's sfx: [{ "name": "drumroll", "at": "start" }]

assets.name: Heartbeat that speeds up
assets.description: A heart that starts slow and is beating more than twice as fast by the end of the shot, each thump harder than the last. For the moment of deciding: a hand over a button, eyes on the gold.
assets.use: a shot's sfx: [{ "name": "heartbeat-rising", "at": "start" }]; it runs for the whole shot

assets.name: Clunk
assets.description: A heavy metal latch going home: the bolt slides, stops hard and rings for a moment. For a door locked, a switch thrown, a lid shut, a choice that cannot be taken back.
assets.use: a shot's sfx: [{ "name": "clunk", "at": "start" }]

assets.name: Boom
assets.description: A deep blow with a long dark tail. For the moment everything turns: the reveal, the betrayal, the number on the screen.
assets.use: a shot's sfx: [{ "name": "boom", "at": "start" }]

assets.name: Bulb hum
assets.description: One bare bulb humming in an empty room, never quite steady, running under a whole shot. What silence sounds like indoors: for a scene with no music at The Table.
assets.use: a shot's sfx: [{ "name": "hum", "at": "start" }]; it runs for the whole shot

assets.name: Game desk

assets.use: props: [{ prop: "game-table", x: 0.5 }]; sitters about two heads from its middle, things on it at y 1.22

assets.name: Golden ball

assets.name: Golden ball, open on STEAL
assets.description: The golden ball with its top swung back and a red disc lifted out of it that reads STEAL.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "ball-steal", x, y: 1.22 }] (y 1.22 stands it on a table top)

assets.name: Golden ball that opens on SPLIT

assets.name: Golden ball that opens on STEAL

assets.use: props: [{ prop: "ball-steal-opening", x, y: 1.22 }] (y 1.22 stands it on a table top)

assets.name: Pile of cash
assets.description: A pile of banknotes in green bundles with paper bands, two to a row and six rows high: the prize on the table.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "cash-pile", x, y: 1.22 }] (y 1.22 stands it on a table top)

assets.name: Half the cash
assets.description: Three rows of banknote bundles: half of the pile of cash, for a prize that has been shared.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "cash-half", x, y: 1.22 }] (y 1.22 stands it on a table top)

assets.name: Sitting, reaching across the table
assets.description: Sitting and leaning in, one arm stretched out over the table to something lying on it.

assets.name: Sitting, hand on heart

assets.name: Sitting, hands thrown up

assets.name: Sitting slumped
assets.description: Sitting with the back bent forward, the head hanging and the hands dropped in the lap.
assets.use: pose: "sit-slump", with a chair at the same x

assets.name: Peaked cap
assets.description: A cap with a round crown, a button on top and a stiff peak that sticks out the way the face is turned, in any cloth color.
assets.use: outfit={outfitFrom({ ...clothes, hat: { kind: 'cap', cloth: 'forest' } })}

assets.name: Striped tie
assets.description: A necktie with a small knot and slanted stripes in a second cloth color, over a shirt or over the bare torso line of a plain stick figure.
assets.use: outfit={outfitFrom({ ...clothes, tie: { cloth: 'crimson', stripe: 'gold' } })}

assets.name: Game-show stage
assets.description: A game-show stage: a curtain across the back wall and one spotlight falling on the middle of the floor.
assets.use: placeSpec('game-show', seed); in a scene: place "game-show" with palette "warm-interior", "danger" or "cold-dawn"

assets.name: Thought or speech bubble
assets.description: A bubble over someone's head with up to three short lines: a cloud for what they think, a balloon with a tail for what they say. A balloon can drift across to someone else and burst on them.

assets.name: Beanie
assets.description: A knitted hat pulled down over the head, with a turned-up ribbed cuff just above the brows and a bobble on top, in any cloth color.
assets.use: outfit={outfitFrom({ ...clothes, hat: { kind: 'beanie', cloth: 'orange' } })}

assets.name: Scarf
assets.description: A scarf wound once round the neck with one fringed tail hanging down the front, over a top or over the bare torso line of a plain stick figure.
assets.use: outfit={outfitFrom({ ...clothes, scarf: { cloth: 'glint' } })}

assets.name: Suspicious
assets.description: Both brows pressed low and uneven, narrowed eyes with the pupils slid to the side, and a flat mouth pulled off centre.
assets.use: face={EXPRESSIONS.suspicious}

assets.name: Wink
assets.description: One eye shut in an arc under a lowered brow, the other open under a raised brow, and a lopsided grin.
assets.use: face={EXPRESSIONS.wink}

assets.name: Open arms
assets.description: Standing with both arms held wide open and the chest lifted: a welcome, trust, "come here".
assets.use: pose: "open-arms"

assets.name: Hand on heart
assets.description: Standing with one hand flat on the chest: a promise, sincerity, "you have my word".
assets.use: pose: "hand-on-heart"

assets.name: Rubbing hands
assets.description: Leaning in with both hands together in front of the chest, one over the other: rubbing the hands at a deal about to go his way.
assets.use: pose: "rub-hands", turned toward the person being worked on

assets.name: Head tilted
assets.description: Standing still with the head tipped to one side: watching someone, weighing them up.
assets.use: pose: "head-tilt", with lookAt set to the person watched

assets.name: Auction podium
assets.description: An auctioneer's podium: a wooden front with one panel, a foot and a gold top, chest high to someone standing beside it.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "podium", x: 0.5 }]; things stand on its top at y: 1.5

assets.name: Gavel in a gloved hand
assets.description: A white-gloved fist and a dark cuff that come up from behind a podium, holding a wooden gavel with its head resting on its block: all that is ever seen of the auctioneer.

assets.name: Gavel raised
assets.description: The gloved hand with the gavel lifted off its block and tipped back, about to come down.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "gavel-raised", x, y: 1.5 }, { prop: "podium", x: 0.5 }]

assets.name: Gavel knocking
assets.description: The gloved hand with the gavel raised as its shot begins; a fifth of a second in it comes down on the block, jumps once and rests.
assets.use: props: [{ prop: "gavel-knock", x, y: 1.5 }, { prop: "podium", x: 0.5 }], with a thud as the shot starts

assets.name: Banknote
assets.description: A plain green banknote facing us with a 1 in an oval in its middle: one dollar, drawn simply and copying no real note.

assets.name: Twenty banknote

assets.name: Paddle, 10¢

assets.name: Paddle, 60¢

assets.name: Classroom

assets.name: Big words over the scene
